recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-40644 or a new work-group decision finalizes broader compatibility rules for fhirVersion-bearing artifacts, or if the work group explicitly wants endpoint-version extension material migrated from the Extension Pack into core.
issue_request: FHIR-18671 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 CapabilityStatement/versioning guidance. It asked to harmonize CapabilityStatement.fhirVersion short and definition text, clarify CapabilityStatement.fhirVersion selection for multi-version servers, avoid mandating endpoint URL shape, state that cross-version resource references are undefined, link fhirVersion usage notes to versioning.html and $versions, and account for non-core support for cross-version endpoint discovery.
initial_application: Jira records application as git 6ee770877b. That commit added Supporting Multiple Versions text to the CapabilityStatement introduction, changed the then-authoritative capabilitystatement spreadsheet fhirVersion short/definition/comment, added cross-FHIR-version reference guidance and a contained-resource same-version rule to references.html, and updated versioning.html to point clients to $versions. The old spreadsheet source has since been refactored into source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml with the relevant wording preserved.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the references/type page and versioning narrative are active build inputs. Current source says a CapabilityStatement describes one particular FHIR version, fhirVersion is 1..1 with no element default, multi-version systems have one statement per supported version, clients use the MIME fhirVersion parameter and $versions for same-endpoint support, endpoint URL shape is not mandated, and cross-version resource references remain undefined. FHIR-17009 is earlier same-family context, FHIR-26065 is a later $versions issue already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-40644 is still Waiting for Input for broader fhirVersion compatibility semantics. The Extension Pack contains an Endpoint FHIR Version extension, so no core source edit is needed for endpoint-version extension material here.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The current build-scope source already conveys the accepted behavior required by FHIR-18671, and adding redundant prose would risk drifting from central versioning guidance without changing implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue established the multiple-version/$versions versioning page context that FHIR-18671 references; it was not independently audited in this seed-limited commit.

Unresolved Waiting for Input issue may later broaden fhirVersion compatibility guidance, but it is not a final decision that changes this reconciliation.
